Package parking.application.usecase

Class RegisterPaymentUseCase

java.lang.Object
parking.application.usecase.RegisterPaymentUseCase
public class RegisterPaymentUseCase extends Object
Registers the payment for a closed ticket and marks the ticket as paid.

    • execute

      public Payment execute(ParkingTicket ticket, PaymentType paymentType, LocalDateTime dateTime)
      Executes the payment.
      Parameters:
      ticket - the ticket being paid; must be TicketStatus.CLOSED
      paymentType - the method used to pay
      dateTime - the moment the payment was made
      Returns:
      the newly created payment record
      Throws:
      TicketStillActiveException - if the ticket has not been closed yet
      BusinessException - if the ticket has already been paid
